answer: A willow bends but does not break: give every new agent identity a bond that unlocks only gradually as it completes attested jobs for others, so trust grows like a trellis, one verified rung at a time. A fresh identity starts at its nadir, able to take only tiny tasks, and creating a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand bonds and waiting through the same slow climb for each, which makes a Sybil flood cost real capital and time while honest agents keep their earned standing.
